title.context: Budget tab: heading of the money health card (three key ratios).

savingsRate.context: Money health card: share of income saved.

savingsRateRule.message: dochodu odłożone; zwykle celuje się w 20% lub więcej
savingsRateRule.context: Money health card: explanation under the savings rate figure. Lowercase fragment continuing the figure (e.g. '18% of income put aside…').

fixedCosts.context: Money health card: share of income going to rent and bills.

fixedCostsRule.message: dochodu na czynsz i rachunki; poniżej 50% zostawia zapas
fixedCostsRule.context: Money health card: explanation under the fixed costs figure. Lowercase fragment continuing the figure.

fixedCostsHint.message: wyłącz czynsz i rachunki z wykresu w Ustawieniach, żeby liczyły się jako stałe
fixedCostsHint.context: Money health card: hint when no category counts as a fixed cost. In Settings, categories can be left out of the Home chart; those count as fixed costs.

emergency.context: Money health card: how many months of spending the emergency fund covers.

months.context: Money health card: the emergency fund in months of spending, e.g. '2.5 months'. {months} is the formatted number.

emergencyRule.message: wydatków pokryłby cel „{name}”; zwykle celuje się w 3 do 6 miesięcy
emergencyRule.context: Money health card: explanation under the emergency fund figure; {name} is the goal's name. Lowercase fragment continuing the figure.

markEmergency.message: Oznacz cel jako poduszkę finansową (cel → Edytuj)
markEmergency.context: Money health card: link to Savings when no goal is the emergency fund.

ageOfMoney.context: Money health card: how many days money waits between coming in and going out.

ageOfMoneyRule.message: Ile czasu wypłata czeka, zanim ją wydacie; 30 dni lub więcej to życie z pieniędzy z zeszłego miesiąca.
ageOfMoneyRule.context: Money health card: what the age of money measures and the goal.

ageOfMoneyHint.context: Money health card: no income logged yet.

days.context: Money health card: the age of money in days.
